This is a five-alarm fire. Black political representation in America is under attack.

Georgia enters the chat


Greg Bluestein (@bluestein)

Breaking: Gov. Kemp has called state lawmakers for a special session on June 17 to reshape both how Georgians vote and to redraw the state’s political maps after last month’s U.S. Supreme Court decision for the 2028 election. #gapol ajc.com/politics/2026/05/gov…

EXCLUSIVE: Alabama AG Steve Marshall tells @livenowfox he wants the state GOP to push for 2 additional red districts.

"7-0 is the number that we need in Alabama."

This would eliminate the state's two Democratic/Black opportunity districts following a SCOTUS decision.

@joycewhitevance.bsky.social argues a SCOTUS voting-rights ruling has sparked an escalating partisan gerrymandering race to the bottom. She says GOP is using redistricting to lock in power, weaken minority representation, while Democrats scramble to counter in kind.
open.substack.com/pub/joycevan...

"Republicans have to gerrymander because they can’t win the hearts and minds of enough voters outright...None of this would be necessary if Republicans believed they could win the midterm elections on the merits. But they don’t, and they know it."

This, exactly.

This administration is so much. Most days it’s too much. But just because it’s off the front pages, we can’t afford to forget about Trump’s inhumane mass deportation policy. Here’s a key update from someone who is doing the real work every day.  open.substack.com/pub/joycevan...

Alabama’s AG announces he’s launched his own investigation into the Southern Poverty Law Center, following the federal criminal indictment. But it looks an awful lot like a witch hunt for donors. www.alabamaag.gov/wp-content/u...

You’ve probably had your limit at this point, please read this explanation of what happened yesterday and share it widely. It’s more important than ever to make sure people understand why we have to vote for democracy and we have to get started now if we want to be able to vote.

Alabama asked the Supreme Court for permission to abandon court-ordered maps and go back to using ones the Court ruled were in violation of the Voting Rights Act, just three years ago, in the wake of Callais. Today, the Supreme Court said yes. open.substack.com/pub/joycevan...

SCOTUS, which ordered Alabama to create a second Black opportunity district just 3 years ago, has lifted that order a week before the primary. The Purcell principle says courts shouldn't permit chaos too close to an election—it's now an open question whether there will even be a primary on schedule.

Join Kica Matos, president of the Nat'l Immigration Law Center & me to discuss law & policy as we get close to SCOTUS’ decision on birthright citizenship. Join us to figure out the intersection of immigration law & scuba diving-click the link to subscribe for free. open.substack.com/pub/joycevan...

The administrative stay in the mifepristone case ends Monday. Unless SCOTUS issues an order regarding whether the injunction should stay in place while the litigation proceeds, the Fifth Circuit’s ban on obtaining the abortion drug via telehealth goes into effect. substack.com/home/post/p-...

@joycewhitevance.bsky.social previews a pivotal week for voting rights and the Supreme Court, warning that recent rulings and redistricting efforts are weakening protections for Black voters and undermining the original purpose of the Voting Rights Act.
open.substack.com/pub/joycevan...

This week: Gerrymandering continues, the NAACP sues, oral argument over Trump’s executive orders against law firms, & the stay in the Mifepriston case ends tomorrow. Lots to get on top of before the week starts & you can do it all here. open.substack.com/pub/joycevan...
